Senior Product Manager – Loyalty & CRM
Falcon Retail Group (fictional test company) · Dubai, United Arab Emirates · On-site

Falcon Retail Group runs 140 retail stores across the GCC. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our loyalty app and CRM platform.

Responsibilities
- Own the loyalty mobile app (iOS and Android) and the CRM roadmap.
- Lead a team of product owners and work with marketing and store operations.
- Grow repeat purchase rate and member engagement.

Requirements
- 12+ years of experience in product management, including 5 years in retail loyalty or CRM.
- Fluent Arabic and English are required.
- Candidates must already hold a valid UAE residence visa.
- Experience with mobile apps and data-driven decision making.

Package
AED 25,000 – 30,000 per month, plus annual bonus.
